module_summary: PicoRV32 multi-cycle RISC-V core: a cpu_state FSM sequences fetch, register read, execute, shift and load/store through a single memory interface FSM, with a predecoder, 32-entry register file, operand registers and ALU, plus optional PCPI, IRQ and trace.

anchors.name: cpu_state
anchors.why: Main core FSM: trap, fetch, ld_rs1, ld_rs2, exec, shift, stmem, ldmem.

anchors.name: cpuregs
anchors.why: Register file written at latched_rd, read via decoded rs1/rs2.

anchors.name: mem_valid
anchors.why: Memory request valid, set by memory FSM for fetch/load/store.

anchors.name: mem_ready
anchors.why: Memory ready completing a transfer (mem_xfer).

anchors.name: mem_addr
anchors.why: Memory address from next PC or reg_op1 via look-ahead address.

anchors.name: mem_wdata
anchors.why: Store data from reg_op2, byte/half replicated.

anchors.name: mem_rdata
anchors.why: Instruction or load data read from memory.

anchors.name: mem_wstrb
anchors.why: Byte write strobes from word size and address alignment.

anchors.name: mem_instr
anchors.why: Marks memory request as instruction fetch.

anchors.name: mem_la_read
anchors.why: Look-ahead read request one cycle before mem_valid.

anchors.name: mem_state
anchors.why: Memory interface FSM sequencing request, wait and completion.

anchors.name: mem_do_rinst
anchors.why: Instruction fetch request flag to memory FSM; triggers decode on done.

anchors.name: mem_do_prefetch
anchors.why: Prefetch next instruction request to memory FSM.

anchors.name: mem_do_rdata
anchors.why: Load data request flag to memory FSM.

anchors.name: mem_do_wdata
anchors.why: Store data request flag driving mem_la_write.

anchors.name: mem_done
anchors.why: Memory operation complete pulse advancing core FSM and decoder.

anchors.name: mem_wordsize
anchors.why: Selects word/half/byte for wdata, wstrb and rdata alignment.

anchors.name: mem_rdata_q
anchors.why: Latched fetched instruction feeding second-stage decode.

anchors.name: reg_pc
anchors.why: Program counter of current instruction; used for AUIPC/JAL link.

anchors.name: reg_next_pc
anchors.why: Next sequential PC feeding next_pc fetch address.

anchors.name: next_pc
anchors.why: Fetch PC: branch target from reg_out or reg_next_pc.

anchors.name: decoder_trigger
anchors.why: Pulse when fetched instruction ready; triggers decode and launch.

anchors.name: decoder_pseudo_trigger
anchors.why: Re-trigger decode without new fetch, suppressing instr refresh.

anchors.name: launch_next_insn
anchors.why: Fetch state with decoded instruction ready and no IRQ pending.

anchors.name: is_lb_lh_lw_lbu_lhu
anchors.why: Representative predecoded opcode class (loads) steering decode and FSM.

anchors.name: instr_jal
anchors.why: Representative per-instruction decode flag.

anchors.name: instr_trap
anchors.why: Illegal/unsupported instruction decode, routes to PCPI or trap.

anchors.name: decoded_rs1
anchors.why: Decoded rs1 index reading register file.

anchors.name: decoded_rs2
anchors.why: Decoded rs2 index for second register operand.

anchors.name: decoded_rd
anchors.why: Decoded destination register index.

anchors.name: latched_rd
anchors.why: Destination index used for register file write-back.

anchors.name: decoded_imm
anchors.why: Decoded immediate for ALU operands, branches and addresses.

anchors.name: reg_op1
anchors.why: ALU operand 1 / load-store address register.

anchors.name: reg_op2
anchors.why: ALU operand 2 / store data register.

anchors.name: alu_out
anchors.why: ALU result mux: add/sub, compare, logic and shift results.

anchors.name: alu_out_0
anchors.why: Compare/branch condition result from eq/lt comparators.

anchors.name: alu_add_sub
anchors.why: Adder/subtractor of reg_op1 and reg_op2.

anchors.name: reg_out
anchors.why: Result register for loads, shifts, counters; write-back and branch target.

anchors.name: reg_sh
anchors.why: Remaining shift amount counter in shift state.

anchors.name: cpuregs_write
anchors.why: Register file write enable in fetch state.

anchors.name: cpuregs_wrdata
anchors.why: Write-back mux: link PC, ALU/reg_out result, IRQ values.

anchors.name: cpuregs_rs1
anchors.why: Register file read port 1 value loaded into reg_op1.

anchors.name: latched_branch
anchors.why: Branch taken flag selecting next_pc target and link write.

anchors.name: latched_store
anchors.why: Pending register write-back flag.

anchors.name: alu_wait
anchors.why: Stall for two-cycle ALU/compare results.

anchors.name: trap
anchors.why: Trap output halting the core on illegal instruction or misalignment.

anchors.name: pcpi_valid
anchors.why: Co-processor request valid (PCPI disabled by parameter).

anchors.name: pcpi_int_ready
anchors.why: Merged co-processor ready from external PCPI, MUL, DIV.

anchors.name: count_cycle
anchors.why: 64-bit cycle counter read by RDCYCLE.

anchors.name: count_instr
anchors.why: 64-bit retired instruction counter read by RDINSTR.

anchors.name: irq_state
anchors.why: IRQ entry sequencing state (IRQ disabled by parameter).

anchors.name: irq_active
anchors.why: Interrupt handler active flag (IRQ disabled).

anchors.name: irq_mask
anchors.why: Software-set IRQ mask register (IRQ disabled).

anchors.name: irq_pending
anchors.why: Pending interrupt bits (IRQ disabled).

anchors.name: timer
anchors.why: IRQ timer countdown (IRQ disabled).

anchors.name: trace_valid
anchors.why: Trace output valid (trace disabled by parameter).

anchors.name: trace_data
anchors.why: Trace payload: branch targets, addresses, results.

groups.name: Core control FSM
groups.description: cpu_state FSM sequencing fetch, operand read, execute, shift and memory phases.

groups.name: Memory interface
groups.description: Memory FSM issuing fetch/load/store requests, aligning data, latching instructions.

groups.name: Instruction decoder
groups.description: Two-stage predecode of fetched word into opcode-class and instruction flags.

groups.name: Register file
groups.description: 32x32 register file with write-back mux and read ports.

groups.name: Execute datapath
groups.description: Operand registers, ALU, shifter and result/PC registers.

groups.name: Counters, IRQ, PCPI and trace
groups.description: Optional cycle/instr counters, interrupt logic, co-processor and trace outputs.
